response.query: Which CI and security practices (container signing, SBOM/vulnerability scanning, immutable artifact releases, end-to-end reproducibility tests) are most practical to enforce for DataLad/DVC-managed datasets and container images?
response.answer: For DataLad/DVC-managed datasets and container images, enforce container signing, SBOM/vulnerability scanning, and end-to-end reproducibility tests. Immutable artifact releases are also crucial for maintaining integrity.
